title: Fine Stone Concrete Pump vs Mortar and Plaster Sprayer
seoTitle: Fine Stone Concrete Pump vs Mortar Sprayer | Pinjin
description: Fine-stone trailer pumps move stone concrete in pipe. Pinjin spraying machines spray mortar, concrete or plaster through a hose at ≤8 mm or ≤4 mm particle. Compare Electric Low Pressure 40 (12–15 m³/h, fine-stone 80/240 m) with the hydraulic sprayer (5 m³/h, ≤8 mm) and M9 plaster (30 L/min, ≤4 mm).
primaryKeyword: fine stone concrete pump vs mortar sprayer

answerBlock.what: A fine-stone concrete pump is a trailer that pipelines concrete whose stone sits in the published aggregate / fine-stone row (example: Electric Low Pressure 40, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, fine-stone 80 m / 240 m). A mortar or plaster sprayer is a finishing machine: Pinjin hydraulic concrete sprayers list 5 or 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, particle ≤8 mm; M9 plaster lists 30 L/min, 50 bar, particle ≤4 mm. They are not interchangeable.
answerBlock.who: Buyers who were quoted both a ‘fine stone pump’ and a ‘mortar sprayer’ for floor or wall work and need the particle-size split.
factors: Particle / stone size: centimetres on trailers versus ≤8 mm or ≤4 mm on sprayers
Output units: m³/h on pumps versus m³/h or L/min on sprayers
Hose versus pipeline DN
Job: structural / floor fill versus finishing spray

faqs.question: Can I pump 1–3 cm stone with a Pinjin spraying machine?
faqs.answer: No. Hydraulic sprayers list particle ≤8 mm; the diesel sprayer lists ≤6 mm; M9 lists ≤4 mm. 1–3 cm stone belongs on a trailer pump such as Electric 15 or Electric 30.

faqs.question: Is the M9 a fine-stone concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. M9 is a 380 V/50 Hz plaster sprayer: 30 L/min, 50 bar, 25 mm hose, particle ≤4 mm, 200 kg. It is not Electric Low Pressure 40.
